description: INEGI estimates 97% of extortion offences went unreported in 2023, and ENVIPE 2025 similarly estimates 97% never reported, due to fear and distrust of authorities. For crimes against businesses the dark figure reached 96.7% in ENVIPE 2024.
energy_note: Ninety-seven per cent of it never reaches anyone.

aspect: The complaint costs a day and produces a folder
description: Filing a denuncia requires hours at a ministerio público, produces a file number, and in most cases nothing further.
energy_note: A day gone, and a reference number.

aspect: Reporting can be the dangerous act
description: Where police are involved with the people complained about - see MIG-002 - reporting identifies the complainant to them.
energy_note: The report reaches the wrong desk on purpose.
